newsitem.title: USA: Trinova to sell three Aeroquip plants.
newsitem.headline: Trinova to sell three Aeroquip plants.

text.p: TRINOVA said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to sell three of its Aeroquip interior automotive plastics facilities to Key Plastics Inc of Novi, Mich.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

The facilities are located in Chesterfield and Port Huron, Mich., and Chihuahua, Mexico. They make display products, instrument clusters and radio bezel assemblies for passenger car, light truck and van applications. Sales volume in 1996 for the three factories was about $30 million, and the facilities have a combined total of about 550 employees.
The sale is expected to close by the end of this month.
TRINOVA's said on Feb 20 that it plans to completely exit its interior automotive plastics business.
